csv-quality-gate

Summary:
- csv-quality-gate is a command-line data quality gate that runs CSV preflight validation and returns pass / warn / fail before a pipeline ingests bad input. Stdlib-only, no third-party runtime dependencies.

Use when:
- You need batch CSV quality checks on one or more files.
- You want to fail fast before ETL, enrichment, or outreach runs.

Do not use when:
- You need semantic validation of records.
- The input is not CSV.
- You need a full data quality platform with lineage, profiling, or schema inference.

Command:
- `csv-quality-gate check leads.csv`
- `csv-quality-gate check leads.csv --profile outreach`
- `csv-quality-gate check leads.csv --json`
- `csv-quality-gate check leads.csv --config csv-quality-gate.toml --profile leads`
- `csv-quality-gate check a.csv b.csv --max-examples 0`

Checks performed:
- Missing required columns
- Empty file (no data rows)
- Empty rate of critical columns vs warning/fail thresholds
- Duplicate rate of a key column vs warning/fail thresholds
- (outreach profile) suspicious company-name patterns via regex
- Project-specific profiles (columns, thresholds, regex patterns) from a TOML or JSON `--config` file

Output:
- Text status: `PASS`, `WARN`, or `FAIL`, one block per file, with an `evidence:` line per row-backed issue
- JSON object with `path`, `profile`, `rows`, `status`, `issues[]`, optional `config`; an array when several paths are given
- Each row-backed issue carries `evidence: {column, total, rows[]}` with bounded line numbers and no cell values

Exit codes:
- `0` pass
- `1` warnings only
- `2` fail, or file not found

Limits:
- Heuristic validation only (empty-rate, duplicate-rate, regex name patterns)
- Outreach profile is opinionated
- Validates shape and obvious noise, not semantic truth
- Evidence is line numbers and counts only, never cell values

Integrations:
- pre-commit hook id `csv-quality-gate` (from `.pre-commit-hooks.yaml`)
- Composite GitHub Action with `csv-path`, `profile`, and optional `config` inputs
- Agent skill `skills/csv-quality-gate/SKILL.md` (portable Agent Plugin `plugin.json`):
  - Claude Code: `claude plugin marketplace add hermes-labs-ai/csv-quality-gate` then `claude plugin install csv-quality-gate@csv-quality-gate`
  - Codex CLI: `codex plugin marketplace add hermes-labs-ai/csv-quality-gate` then `codex plugin add csv-quality-gate@csv-quality-gate`
  - Gemini CLI: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/csv-quality-gate --ref main`

Part of the Hermes Labs reliability stack:
- See https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai for the other open-source reliability tools. csv-quality-gate guards pipeline input data; it complements, and does not replace, the agent- and prompt-level tools in the stack.

About Hermes Labs:
- Hermes Labs is an independent AI-reliability lab building open-source tools that catch silent failure modes in production AI. More at https://hermes-labs.ai
